upcomingElectionDeadlines.label: Last day to register and still be mailed a ballot. After this, you can still register and vote in person.
Last suggested day to return a ballot by mail. After this, use a drop box or voting center.
Election Day. Ballots must be received, or you must be in line, by 7 p.m.
